Help
✕

What this does: This tool extracts individual objects from uploaded images with transparent backgrounds, and provides you the separate images ready to name and download.

How to use:

  • Upload or paste an image.
  • Click “Convert” to split the image into individual parts.
  • Click on parts to name or download them.
  • Use “Name Images” to assign names before downloading.
  • Double-click any image to view it full size (6x bigger).
  • In modal view, you can scroll to see the entire enlarged image.
  • Select images and press Delete to remove them (with confirmation).
